description: Human opening book for the 1200/1400 presets: Lichess rated Blitz+Rapid games, average rating 1400-1799 (= explorer ratings=1400,1600), first 12 plies. Moves need >= 5% share and >= 50 games in a position with >= 300 games, and must lose <= 50cp vs Stockfish best (depth 18). Sampled by game count.
